## 🔍 Verification Checklist

### ⚙️ Code Quality & Compilation
- [ ] Code builds cleanly with `npm run build`
- [ ] No TypeScript compiler errors: `npm run lint` compiles cleanly
- [ ] No dead code or console logging statements left in

### 🛡️ Security Check
- [ ] Prompt templates are fully parameterized and protected against injection
- [ ] No API keys, passwords, or secrets are hardcoded or exposed to the client
- [ ] Input size validation is checked on all endpoints

### 🧪 Tests & Coverage
- [ ] Existing tests run and pass cleanly: `npm run test`
- [ ] New unit or integration tests have been added to cover changes
- [ ] Test coverage meets or exceeds **98%**

### ♿ Accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA)
- [ ] Semantic HTML is utilized throughout
- [ ] Screen readers read elements clearly (`aria-label`, landmarks)
- [ ] Color contrast is fully compliant
- [ ] Keyboard navigation is fully supported for all interactive elements
